stations.title: Customer
stations.say: Is KP-60100 still on the van?

stations.title: Kes
stations.text: Answers in a chat that remembers.

captions: Depot requests are safe now. Next, a customer chats with Kes all afternoon.
Partway through, every new question ends in an error.
You make it fail, fix it and write the test, in three tasks.
Now every check gets an answer, however long the chat runs.
Same customer, no dead chat. Kes stays itself to the last answer.
